exitCodes.2: CHECK_FAIL (a required check failed, or an exception event was recorded)
exitCodes.8: TIMEOUT (a timeout event, or a child process without an exit code)
exitCodes.9: EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE_STALE (required summary missing, or the on-disk verdict does not match the computed one)
exitCodes.10: BLOCKED_REQUIRED (a required item is BLOCKED or NOT_RUN: e.g. hardware gate not established, MSI_DEVICE_PENDING)

hardRules: never pass --real-backend to the fan host (no EC/HID/HC write path)
action precondition: the hardware gate is read through side-effect-free GET /api/state; unknown/open => 0 change calls
/api/handshake is NOT side-effect free (it rewrites HardwareCapable/AuthorizationGranted/FanRoute/DeviceIdentity) and is used only on a sandbox host this run started
cleanup only touches processes this run started (pid + creation time + image identity); foreign same-name processes are refused
reverse evidence is bound to the log offsets taken before the edges (historical hits can never pass)
never stop foreign processes; never claim a real Windows sleep for an HTTP injection
one verdict source (Complete-SimRun): required failures/missing/timeouts/exceptions/missing summaries can never exit 0
